name: Connel
method: tidetimes.org.uk Connel vs its own Tobermory (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Tobermory: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: Height = offset + scale * Tobermory: Connel's range is ~25% smaller. Tidetimes' Connel is the Admiralty's, which doesn't model the Falls of Lora: inside the narrows the loch lags and drains on its own (see the streams page). One height map for HW and LW: separate ones fitted under 0.01 m better but don't cross inside the range, so the curve would miss the turns. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Connel vs Tobermory, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 541 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
